svg.title: The transactional outbox
svg.desc: The shop saves the order and an outbox row in one transaction. A relay reads the unsent row, publishes it to the broker and marks it sent. If the relay crashes before it marks the row, it publishes the same row again, and the consumer drops the duplicate by message id. Save both together: 1. Shop service calls Orders and outbox: order + outbox row, one transaction. 2. Orders and outbox replies to Shop service: both saved or neither. Publish later: 3. Relay calls Orders and outbox: unsent rows. 4. Orders and outbox replies to Relay: OrderPlaced row. 5. Relay calls Broker: publish. 6. Broker sends to Consumer: OrderPlaced. 7. Relay sends to Orders and outbox: mark sent. Relay crashed before marking: 8. Relay calls Orders and outbox: unsent rows. 9. Orders and outbox replies to Relay: same row, still unsent. 10. Relay calls Broker: publish again. 11. Broker sends to Consumer: OrderPlaced again. 12. Consumer sends to Consumer: seen this id, drop it, refused.
